title: Multiple-Choice Secretary Problem with Predictions
abstract: arXiv:2611.14651v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: We study the multiple-choice secretary problem, in which candidates arrive in uniformly random order and the goal is to select at most $k$ candidates to maximize their total value. We consider a setting where predictions of individual candidate values are available before any candidate arrives. Fujii and Yoshida's Learned Kleinberg algorithm achieves competitive loss $O(\min\{\log k/\sqrt{k},\eps\})$, where $k$ is the selection capacity and $\eps$ is the maximum multiplicative prediction error. We remove the logarithmic factor through a sharper analysis of the same switching algorithm with a retuned threshold. The resulting competitive ratio is at least $\max\{0,1-\min\{32/\sqrt{k},4\eps\}\}$. In particular, exact predictions ($\eps=0$) achieve the offline optimum on every arrival order.

translated_title: 带预测的多选秘书问题
translated_abstract: 我们研究多选秘书问题：候选人以均匀随机的顺序依次到达，目标是从中选出至多 $k$ 名候选人，以最大化所选候选人的总价值。我们考虑这样一个设定：在任意候选人到达之前，可以获得对每位候选人价值的预测。Fujii 和 Yoshida 提出的 Learned Kleinberg 算法实现了竞争损失 $O(\min\{\log k/\sqrt{k},\eps\})$，其中 $k$ 是选择容量，$\eps$ 是最大乘法预测误差。我们通过对同一切换算法进行更精细的分析并重新调整阈值，去除了其中的对数因子。所得算法的竞争比至少为 $\max\{0,1-\min\{32/\sqrt{k},4\eps\}\}$。特别地，当预测完全准确（$\eps=0$）时，算法在每一种到达顺序下都能达到离线最优值。
tldr: 本文通过对切换算法更精细的分析和重新调整阈值，去除了带预测多选秘书问题中 Learned Kleinberg 算法竞争损失的对数因子，将竞争比提升至至少 max{0, 1−min{32/√k, 4ε}}，并在预测完全准确时对任意到达顺序均达到离线最优。
en_tdlr: This paper removes the logarithmic factor in the competitive loss of the Learned Kleinberg algorithm for the multiple-choice secretary problem with predictions through a sharper analysis and a retuned threshold, achieving a competitive ratio of at least max{0, 1−min{32/√k, 4ε}} and attaining the offline optimum for every arrival order when predictions are exact.
